'''Gorima''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Gorima, a famous [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] on his [[Planet/Legends|planet]], was hired by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rian Darok]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] and [[Darth Arkous]] of the [[Dark Council]] on the behalf of the [[Order of Revan]]. Darok and Arkous tasked Gorima with the creation of an "[[Infinite Army]]" using [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] technology fused with living beings.<ref name="FAII" />

Gorima conducted his studies in an underwater facility on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. When he arrived to a satisfactory result, however, Republic and Imperial strike teams sent by [[Theron Shan]] and [[Lana Beniko]] fought their ways in the base and confronted him. Darok and Arkous, who observed the situation from a distance, then activated the facility's self-destruct system.<ref name="FAII" /> Gorima died in the destruction, as later confirmed by [[Darth Xarion]].<ref name="Analysis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gorima first appeared in Game Update 2.9 of the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2014]]. If the player character chooses the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] conversational option, Gorima is murdered by Jakarro. If the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] option is chosen, Gorima's life is spared,<ref name="FAII" /> but he dies in the facility's destruction.<ref name="Analysis" />
